summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sauna CRM module - Kanban board for sauna leads management. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified and working correctly.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (console warning)

seed_data_creation: Test lead 'CRM-TEST-001' exists in qualified stage

landing_page_crm_card.details: CRM Sauny card visible on landing page for users with sauna_crm access. Card shows Kanban icon and description 'Zarządzanie leadami saun z tablicą Kanban i integracją amoCRM'

crm_page_kanban_board.details: CRM page loads with 3 Kanban stages: Новая заявка (blue), Квалифицированная заявка (orange), Создано КП (green). Each stage shows lead count badge.

settings_dialog_fields_tab.details: Settings dialog opens with Fields tab showing 10 configurable fields (Поле 1-10). Each field has enable/disable checkbox and amoCRM field ID mapping input.

settings_dialog_stages_tab.details: Stages tab shows 3 stages with color pickers, stage name inputs, amoCRM stage ID and pipeline ID inputs. Add stage button and delete buttons work correctly.

create_new_lead.details: New lead dialog opens with all fields: Имя клиента, Телефон, Email, Этап (stage dropdown), Адрес, Дополнительные поля (Поле 1-5), Примечания, Важная заявка checkbox. Lead created successfully and appears in Kanban.

edit_lead_dialog.details: Edit dialog opens with pre-filled data. Title shows 'Редактировать заявку'. All fields editable.

stage_change_dropdown.details: Stage dropdown on lead card shows all 3 stages with colored indicators. Selecting new stage moves lead to correct column and updates counts.

calculator_button.details: Calculator button opens new tab with sauna calculator. URL includes calc=sauna and crmLeadId parameters for prefilling.

backend_api_get_leads.details: GET /api/sauna-crm/leads returns leads array, byStage grouping, and settings object with fields and stages.

backend_api_create_lead.details: POST /api/sauna-crm/leads creates new lead with stageHistory tracking.

backend_api_change_stage.details: PUT /api/sauna-crm/leads/{id}/stage changes lead stage and updates stageHistory.

backend_api_settings.details: GET/POST /api/sauna-crm/settings returns and saves CRM configuration.

backend_api_amocrm_sync.details: POST /api/sauna-crm/sync-from-amocrm returns 400 'amoCRM not configured' as expected (no amoCRM credentials configured).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sauna CRM module fully functional. Backend test file /app/tests/test_sauna_crm.py covers 15 test cases for CRUD operations, settings, stage changes, and calculator integration. amoCRM sync endpoints return expected 'not configured' error since no amoCRM credentials are set up in test environment. UI uses Russian language for CRM-specific text. Test data cleaned up after testing.
